definition_en: The general project of making a model's internal computation or its outputs intelligible to humans. In AI safety it is load-bearing: you cannot verify that a model is not deceiving you if you cannot inspect what it is doing.
definition_zh: 让人类能够理解模型的内部计算过程或其输出依据的研究方向。在 AI 安全语境下，它是验证模型是否"表里如一"的前提——看不懂模型在做什么，就无法确认它没有欺骗你。
pitfalls: 可解释性 is fully established but is doing double duty. In the older Chinese XAI/ML-security literature (2019-2022) it means post-hoc explanation of a prediction — saliency maps, LIME/SHAP, feature attribution. In the newer Anthropic-lineage literature it means reverse-engineering the computation itself. Chinese writers do not have separate words for these, so a claim that a system 具有可解释性 can mean anything from 'we plotted a heatmap' to 'we traced the circuit'. In the PRC policy register 可解释性 additionally sits next to 透明性 and is treated as a compliance property, not a research programme. 可理解性 exists but is rare; 可释性 is not used.

translations.notes: Universal across the academic, industry and policy registers. No competitor.

attestations.quote_zh: 可解释性被定义为向人类解释或以呈现可理解的术语的能力
attestations.quote_en: Interpretability is defined as the ability to explain to humans, or to present in understandable terms.
attestations.source_title: 机器学习模型可解释性方法、应用与安全研究综述
attestations.publisher: 《计算机研究与发展》(纪守领、李进锋、杜天宇、李博)

attestations.quote_zh: 不断提高人工智能可解释性、可预测性，为人工智能系统内部构造、推理逻辑、技术接口、输出结果提供明确说明
attestations.quote_en: Continuously improve the interpretability and predictability of AI, and provide clear explanations of AI systems' internal construction, reasoning logic, technical interfaces and outputs.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全治理框架【AI知识库】
attestations.publisher: 清华大学人工智能国际治理研究院 / 智源社区 (原文为全国网络安全标准化技术委员会《人工智能安全治理框架》)

translations.notes: Occasionally used as a near-synonym, and shows up in translations of NIST-style taxonomies that separate transparency / understandability / explainability. Not the field's word; recommend against it for 'interpretability'.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: 《人工智能安全治理框架》 lists 模型算法可解释性差的风险 as a named risk category
《从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来》

usage_examples.zh: 可解释性研究的目标是把模型从黑箱变成可以检查的对象。
usage_examples.en: The goal of interpretability research is to turn the model from a black box into something you can inspect.

definition_en: Reverse-engineering the algorithms a neural network actually implements — identifying features, the circuits that connect them, and the causal role each plays — rather than explaining individual predictions after the fact.
definition_zh: 把神经网络当作一段需要逆向工程的程序来研究：找出模型内部的特征、特征之间构成的回路，以及每一部分在计算中承担的因果作用，而不是事后为某个预测编一个解释。
pitfalls: Genuinely contested between 机制可解释性 and 机械可解释性, and the difference matters. 机制 = mechanism (as in 作用机制, 'mechanism of action', the sense Chris Olah intends). 机械 = mechanical / machine-like, and in ordinary Chinese 机械 carries a strong pejorative sense of 'rigid, rote, unthinking' (机械地照搬 = to copy mechanically). 机械可解释性 is a plausible-looking mistranslation that is nevertheless in real use, including in translated paper abstracts — the hint that it is 'a plausible mistranslation worth flagging' is confirmed, but it is not rare. Recommend 机制可解释性. A third common move is to keep the English inline: 机器之心 writes 'mechanistic interpretability（机制可解释性）'.

translations.notes: The better and apparently more widely used rendering in Chinese ML media and survey translations. Usually introduced with the English in parentheses on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability, MI）逐渐发展为一个重要研究方向。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has gradually developed into an important research direction.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性 (MI) 是一个新兴的研究领域，旨在通过将神经网络的复杂计算分解为可理解的内部组件和因果机制来"逆向工程"神经网络。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is an emerging research field that aims to 'reverse-engineer' neural networks by decomposing their complex computation into understandable internal components and causal mechanisms.
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性：AI显微镜动态追踪和复原模型推理过程
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability: the AI microscope dynamically traces and reconstructs the model's reasoning process.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

translations.notes: In genuine use — including in Chinese renderings of paper abstracts — but 机械 imports a 'rigid / rote' connotation that 机制 does not, and misreads 'mechanistic' as 'mechanical'. Recommend against, while acknowledging a reader will meet it.

attestations.quote_zh: 机械可解释性作为理解大语言模型内部运作机制的一种方法，引起了研究界的广泛关注。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability, as an approach to understanding the internal workings of large language models, has attracted broad attention from the research community.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

translations.notes: Chinese ML media routinely keep the English term inline, glossing it once in parentheses. This is the single most reliable way to be understood.

attestations.quote_zh: SAE 的新兴技术正迅速崛起，成为当前最热门的 mechanistic interpretability（机制可解释性）路线之一
attestations.quote_en: The emerging SAE technique is rising rapidly, becoming one of the hottest mechanistic interpretability directions right now.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

used_by.note: consistently, with English gloss
in its 2025 interpretability landscape report

usage_examples.zh: 机制可解释性希望像逆向工程一段程序那样，把模型内部真正运行的算法读出来。
usage_examples.en: Mechanistic interpretability wants to read out the algorithm the model actually runs, the way you would reverse-engineer a program.

definition_en: The pre-LLM research tradition of producing human-legible explanations for model decisions — saliency maps, LIME, SHAP, feature attribution, surrogate models — largely motivated by high-stakes deployment (medicine, credit, justice) rather than by misalignment risk.
definition_zh: 大模型之前就存在的研究传统，目标是为模型的单次决策给出人能看懂的解释：显著图、LIME、SHAP、特征归因、代理模型等。它的动机主要是医疗、信贷、司法等高风险场景下的问责，而不是失控风险。
pitfalls: Not a translation problem but a discourse-mapping problem. Chinese academia has a large, mature XAI literature (《计算机研究与发展》, 《计算机学报》, 南大/浙大 groups) predating the Anthropic lineage by years, and it owns the phrase 可解释性. A Chinese reader who hears 可解释性 will by default picture LIME/SHAP/显著图, not SAEs and circuits. Anyone importing mech-interp vocabulary into Chinese is speaking into a room that already has a different referent for the umbrella word. The bare acronym XAI is used untranslated very freely.

translations.notes: Standard in Chinese academic writing since roughly 2019. Often written 可解释人工智能（XAI）; the bare acronym XAI is then reused throughout.
The acronym is used bare in Chinese sentences with no expansion, exactly as in English.

used_by.org: 《计算机研究与发展》(中科院计算所)
used_by.zh_used: 可解释性 / 可解释人工智能
used_by.note: multiple survey articles 2019-2020

usage_examples.zh: 早期的可解释人工智能主要靠显著图和 SHAP 值，解释的是单次预测，而不是模型内部的算法。
usage_examples.en: Early explainable AI relied mainly on saliency maps and SHAP values; it explained a single prediction, not the algorithm inside the model.

definition_en: A system whose inputs and outputs are observable but whose internal decision process is not. The standard framing for why interpretability is needed.
definition_zh: 只能看到输入和输出、看不到内部决策过程的系统。这是解释"为什么需要可解释性"时最常用的比喻。
pitfalls: 黑箱 and 黑盒 are both fully current and freely interchangeable; there is no semantic difference, only register drift. 黑箱 (box/chest) is slightly more literary and dominates in media and policy prose; 黑盒 is more common in engineering writing and in the compound 黑盒测试 (black-box testing), where it is the fixed term. Note that TC260's governance framework avoids both and writes 黑灰盒 ('black-grey box') — a hedge asserting that model reasoning is only partly opaque, which is a substantive framing choice, not a stylistic one.

translations.notes: Dominant in media, popular-science and policy prose.

attestations.quote_zh: 深度学习模型通常被视作'黑箱'，其内在运行机制无法被其开发者理解
attestations.quote_en: Deep learning models are usually regarded as 'black boxes' whose internal workings cannot be understood even by their developers.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

attestations.quote_zh: 中间部分——模型是怎么根据这些算法和数据输出结果，就成为了不可见的「黑箱」
attestations.quote_en: The middle part — how the model produces an output from these algorithms and data — becomes an invisible 'black box'.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元，OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍

translations.notes: Equally acceptable; the fixed term in 黑盒测试 (black-box testing) and common in engineering writing. Note the 新智元 piece above uses 黑盒 in its headline and 黑箱 in its body — the two are simply interchangeable.

attestations.quote_zh: 它能够将模型内部的黑盒表示分解为一组稀疏、具备明确语义的激活特征
attestations.quote_en: It can decompose the model's internal black-box representations into a set of sparse activation features with clear semantics.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

translations.notes: TC260's chosen wording in 《人工智能安全治理框架》. Restricted to the PRC policy register; asserts partial rather than total opacity. Do not use in technical writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 以深度学习为代表的人工智能算法内部运行逻辑复杂，推理过程属黑灰盒模式，可能导致输出结果难以预测和确切归因
attestations.quote_en: AI algorithms typified by deep learning have complex internal logic and a black-grey-box inference process, which can make outputs hard to predict and hard to attribute precisely.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全治理框架【AI知识库】
attestations.publisher: 清华大学人工智能国际治理研究院 / 智源社区 (原文为 TC260《人工智能安全治理框架》)

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: 《人工智能安全治理框架》 model-and-algorithm risk section

usage_examples.zh: 把大模型当成黑箱来监管，和把它拆开来看，是两条不同的治理路径。
usage_examples.en: Regulating a large model as a black box and opening it up to look inside are two different governance paths.

definition_en: An autoencoder trained with a sparsity penalty on a model's activations, so that it learns an overcomplete dictionary of directions each of which fires rarely and tends to correspond to a single human-legible concept. The main practical tool for undoing superposition.
definition_zh: 在模型激活上训练、并施加稀疏约束的自编码器：它学出一个维度远高于原激活的"字典"，其中每个方向只在少数输入上激活，往往对应一个人能看懂的概念。目前拆解叠加现象最主流的工具。
pitfalls: The Chinese term is settled, but the hint is confirmed: in running Chinese text the bare Latin 'SAE' dominates after first mention, and many writers introduce the concept in English first ('一种叫做 Sparse Autoencoder（简称 SAE）的新兴技术'). A minor variant 稀疏自动编码器 (with 自动) is also attested. Do not confuse 稀疏自编码器 with the generic pre-2020 sparse autoencoder of classical deep learning, which is the same architecture used for a completely different purpose (representation learning, not interpretation).

translations.notes: The standard Chinese term. Almost always followed by （SAE）on first use, after which the acronym takes over.

attestations.quote_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为一种有前景的方法，鉴于它们能够将大语言模型中复杂且叠加的特征解耦为更具可解释性的组件。
attestations.quote_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a promising approach, given their ability to disentangle the complex, superposed features in large language models into more interpretable components.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

attestations.quote_zh: 利用稀疏自编码器技术（sparse autoencoder）分析GPT-4模型的内部激活。研究人员成功提取出了数以千万计的稀疏特征
attestations.quote_en: Using sparse autoencoder techniques to analyse GPT-4's internal activations, researchers successfully extracted tens of millions of sparse features.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

translations.notes: The dominant form in running text. Chinese practitioners write 'SAE 特征', 'SAE 训练', 'SAE 路线' without expansion.

attestations.quote_zh: 一种叫做 Sparse Autoencoder（简称 SAE）的新兴技术正迅速崛起
attestations.quote_en: An emerging technique called the Sparse Autoencoder (SAE for short) is rising rapidly.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

attestations.quote_zh: 从传统的神经元（Neuron）到近年来广泛使用的稀疏自编码器特征（SAE Feature）。
attestations.quote_en: From the traditional neuron to the sparse-autoencoder feature (SAE Feature) that has been widely used in recent years.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

translations.notes: Older/longer variant, seen in 2023-era coverage. Same thing; 稀疏自编码器 is now more usual.

attestations.quote_zh: 使用了一种称为稀疏自动编码器的弱字典学习算法
attestations.quote_en: They used a weak dictionary-learning algorithm called a sparse autoencoder.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元！OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍

used_by.note: coverage of the 2025 SAE survey
2025 interpretability landscape report

usage_examples.zh: 他们在中间层训练了一个 SAE，把稠密激活拆成几万个稀疏特征。
usage_examples.en: They trained an SAE on the middle layer, decomposing the dense activations into tens of thousands of sparse features.

definition_en: A variant of the sparse autoencoder that reads from and writes to several layers — or several models — at once, learning one shared dictionary across them. Used to resolve cross-layer superposition, to strip duplicate features out of circuits, and above all for model diffing (finding what a fine-tune changed).
definition_zh: 稀疏自编码器的一种变体：同时从多个层（甚至多个模型）读取和写回激活，学习一部共享的特征字典。主要用于处理跨层叠加、剔除回路中的重复特征，以及"模型对比"——找出微调到底改变了什么。
pitfalls: This is the clearest false-friend trap in the category. The obvious calque 交叉编码器 is already a fully occupied slot in Chinese ML: it is the settled term for the retrieval cross-encoder, the reranker that jointly encodes a query-document pair, contrasted with 双编码器 (bi-encoder). A Chinese NLP engineer who reads 交叉编码器 will think 'reranker', not 'Anthropic interpretability architecture'. 跨编码器 avoids the collision but is barely attested and would still be heard as a variant spelling of the reranker. Meanwhile the adjacent Anthropic architecture cross-layer transcoder DOES have a settled Chinese rendering — 跨层转码器 — because Chinese media covered the 2025 circuit-tracing papers; crosscoder got no comparable coverage. Practical advice: write the English word, or 稀疏跨编码器（crosscoder）with the English attached.

translations.notes: Chinese-language treatment of this term is essentially limited to reading notes and paper summaries that keep the English title and the English word. I could not recover a verbatim Chinese sentence containing an accepted Chinese rendering, so no attestation is recorded — the gap itself is the finding.

We propose this, with the English attached on first use. 跨 (across/spanning) correctly conveys 'reads across layers/models' and does not collide with the established 交叉编码器 reranker; 编码器 keeps the family resemblance to 稀疏自编码器. Not attested in a source we could fetch — this is a coinage, not a report.
Do not use for crosscoder. In Chinese this string already means the retrieval cross-encoder / reranker and nothing else; the attestation below is included precisely to show the collision.

attestations.quote_zh: 总的来说，Transformer编码器（双编码器）负责快速检索，而Cross-Encoder（交叉编码器）负责精准排序。
attestations.quote_en: In short, the Transformer encoder (bi-encoder) handles fast retrieval while the Cross-Encoder (交叉编码器) handles precise ranking.
attestations.source_title: Transformer架构的 Bi-Encoder （双编码器模型）, Cross-Encoder（交叉编码器）重排序模型

usage_examples.zh: 他们用 crosscoder 对比 base 模型和 chat 模型，找出微调新增的特征。
usage_examples.en: They used a crosscoder to diff the base and chat models and find the features the fine-tune added.

definition_en: In mechanistic interpretability, a direction in a model's activation space that corresponds to a human-legible concept and serves as the basic unit of computation — not an input variable and not a neuron.
definition_zh: 在机制可解释性里，特征指激活空间中的一个方向，它对应一个人类能理解的概念，并作为模型计算的基本单元。它既不是输入变量，也不等于某个神经元。
pitfalls: 特征 is the correct word but it is badly overloaded, and the overload is worse in Chinese than in English because Chinese has no separate everyday word for 'trait'. In classical ML 特征 = input variable (特征工程 = feature engineering), and the whole XAI tradition uses 特征归因 = feature attribution over input features. The mech-interp sense — a learned direction, discovered rather than designed — is a different object. Chinese writers disambiguate ad hoc: 特征单元, SAE 特征, 可解释特征, 稀疏特征, or keep the English 'feature' in parentheses. 'Latent' as a synonym is not usually rendered; 潜变量/隐变量 would be read as VAE latents.

translations.notes: Universal, but usually qualified (SAE 特征 / 可解释特征 / 稀疏特征 / 特征单元) when the interp sense is meant.

attestations.quote_zh: 第一步，识别特征——特征指的是模型在计算中使用的可被解释的构建模块。
attestations.quote_en: Step one, identify features — features are the interpretable building blocks the model uses in its computation.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

attestations.quote_zh: 该方法包括两步，首先，将特征作为识别模型计算中使用的可解释基础单元。其次，描述这些特征如何通过过程或回路相互作用以产生模型输出。
attestations.quote_en: The method has two steps: first, treat features as the interpretable basic units used in the model's computation; second, describe how these features interact through processes or circuits to produce the model's output.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路

translations.notes: A useful disambiguating variant when 特征 alone would read as 'input feature'.

attestations.quote_zh: SAE 会解构出若干稀疏激活的'特征单元'（feature）
attestations.quote_en: The SAE decomposes things into a number of sparsely activating 'feature units'.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

used_by.note: in its 大模型可解释性读书会 materials

usage_examples.zh: 这里说的特征不是输入变量，而是激活空间中的一个方向。
usage_examples.en: The features here are not input variables but directions in activation space.

definition_en: The hypothesis that a network represents more features than it has dimensions by packing them into overlapping, non-orthogonal directions — which is why individual neurons end up polysemantic.
definition_zh: 叠加假说认为：网络要表示的概念数量远多于它的维度，于是把这些概念压缩进彼此不正交、相互重叠的方向里。这正是单个神经元表现出多义性的原因。
pitfalls: Rare good case: the metaphor is a physics loan in both languages, and 叠加 is exactly the word Chinese physics uses (量子叠加态, 波的叠加), so the connotation transfers cleanly. The only risk is that bare 叠加 in an ML context can be read as 'stacking/summation' (e.g. 叠加多层), so 叠加现象 or 叠加假说 is safer. Chinese sources almost always attach the English (superposition) on first use.

translations.notes: Usually written 叠加现象 or 叠加假说 in running text, with the English in parentheses on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 大模型内部的神经元具有多重语义（polysemantic）的特性，即一个神经元往往混合表示了多个彼此无关的概念，由此产生了叠加（superposition）现象
attestations.quote_en: Neurons inside large models are polysemantic — a single neuron often mixes representations of several unrelated concepts — which gives rise to the superposition phenomenon.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

attestations.quote_zh: 而神经元多语义的一个潜在原因是叠加，这是一种假设的现象
attestations.quote_en: One potential cause of neuron polysemanticity is superposition, a hypothesised phenomenon.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元，OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍

attestations.quote_zh: 这使得模型能够表示比神经元数量更多的概念，从而有效地逆转了导致单个神经元多义性的叠加现象。
attestations.quote_en: This lets the model represent more concepts than it has neurons, effectively reversing the superposition that makes individual neurons polysemantic.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

translations.notes: Used when referring to the claim rather than the phenomenon (Anthropic's Toy Models of Superposition).

used_by.note: 2025 interpretability landscape report

usage_examples.zh: 由于叠加的存在，一个神经元的激活几乎不可能只对应一个概念。
usage_examples.en: Because of superposition, a single neuron's activation almost never corresponds to just one concept.

definition_en: The property of a single neuron responding to several unrelated concepts, so that reading off 'what a neuron means' is impossible. The empirical symptom that superposition explains.
definition_zh: 同一个神经元会对多个毫不相关的概念做出反应，因此无法说清"这个神经元代表什么"。它是叠加现象在观测层面的表现。
pitfalls: Three renderings are in live use with no winner: 多义性 (borrowed from linguistics, where 多义词 = polysemous word — the closest analogue to the English coinage), 多语义(性) (a more literal poly-+semantic calque), and 多重语义 (descriptive, 'multiple semantics'). Because 多义性 is a pre-existing linguistics term, a Chinese reader may first think of lexical ambiguity rather than neuron overloading; conversely 多语义性 reads as a fresh technical coinage but is less idiomatic. The antonym is 单义性 / 单语义性 (monosemanticity), inheriting the same split.

translations.notes: Our recommendation: shortest, matches the linguistics term 多义词, and the antonym 单义性 works cleanly.

attestations.quote_zh: 这使得模型能够表示比神经元数量更多的概念，从而有效地逆转了导致单个神经元多义性的叠加现象。
attestations.quote_en: This lets the model represent more concepts than it has neurons, effectively reversing the superposition that makes individual neurons polysemantic.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

translations.notes: The 2023-era rendering, still common. Its antonym 单语义性 was used to render Anthropic's 'Towards Monosemanticity'.
Descriptive variant used by 腾讯研究院; reads more naturally in prose but is not a noun-form term.

attestations.quote_zh: 大模型内部的神经元具有多重语义（polysemantic）的特性，即一个神经元往往混合表示了多个彼此无关的概念
attestations.quote_en: Neurons inside large models have a polysemantic character: one neuron often mixes representations of several unrelated concepts.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

usage_examples.zh: 神经元的多义性意味着你不能靠看单个神经元来理解模型。
usage_examples.en: Neuron polysemanticity means you cannot understand the model by looking at individual neurons.

definition_en: A subgraph of a network — specific features, attention heads and MLP paths wired together — that implements an identifiable algorithm, such as copying a repeated token or resolving an indirect object.
definition_zh: 网络中的一个子图：若干特征、注意力头和 MLP 路径连成一条通路，共同实现一个可辨认的算法，比如复制重复出现的 token，或判断间接宾语是谁。
pitfalls: Genuinely contested between 回路 and 电路, and the hint is only half right. 电路 is not simply wrong — it is used by serious sources (机器之心 writes 跨层电路; 腾讯研究院 writes 计算电路（computational circuits）) — but it means 'electrical circuit' literally, which over-commits to the hardware metaphor. 回路 means 'loop / return path' and is the term used by the interpretability reading-group community (集智俱乐部), and is the safer default: it keeps the graph-path sense without asserting electronics. Note 集智 also coins 工作回路 ('working circuit') for Anthropic's circuit tracing. A large fraction of Chinese writing simply keeps the English 'circuit' or writes Transformer circuits. Separately, beware 脑回路: in colloquial Chinese 脑回路 ('brain circuit') is slang for 'someone's weird way of thinking' and appears in clickbait headlines about Claude — vivid, but not a technical term.

translations.notes: Our recommendation. Used by 集智俱乐部's 大模型可解释性读书会 and by 雷峰网's Anthropic coverage.

attestations.quote_zh: 本次分享将介绍由注意力头和前馈网络组成的Transformer circuits（回路）的基本概念
attestations.quote_en: This talk will introduce the basic concept of Transformer circuits, made up of attention heads and feed-forward networks.
attestations.source_title: 大模型怎样工作？Transformer回路基础丨周四直播·大模型可解释性读书会

attestations.quote_zh: 其次，描述这些特征如何通过过程或回路相互作用以产生模型输出。
attestations.quote_en: Second, describe how these features interact through processes or circuits to produce the model's output.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路

translations.notes: In real, respectable use — not a mistranslation, but it hard-codes the electronics metaphor. Prefer 回路 unless matching a source that already used 电路.

attestations.quote_zh: 从单个神经元到注意力头，再到跨层电路。
attestations.quote_en: From individual neurons to attention heads, and then to cross-layer circuits.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 将这些稀疏特征有机组合为'计算电路'（computational circuits），从中追踪模型如何在层层传递中完成由输入到输出的决策路径
attestations.quote_en: Organically combining these sparse features into 'computational circuits', and tracing how the model completes its decision path from input to output layer by layer.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

translations.notes: Frequently kept in English, especially in the fixed phrase Transformer circuits and in paper titles.

used_by.note: 大模型可解释性读书会 series title
跨层电路 in its 2026 interpretability survey coverage

usage_examples.zh: 他们定位到一条负责复制重复 token 的回路，只涉及三个注意力头。
usage_examples.en: They localised a circuit responsible for copying repeated tokens that involves only three attention heads.

definition_en: An attention head (really a two-head composition) that implements the pattern [A][B] … [A] → [B]: it finds the earlier occurrence of the current token and copies whatever followed it. Widely argued to be the mechanistic basis of in-context learning.
definition_zh: 一种（实际由两层注意力头组合而成的）注意力头，实现 [A][B] … [A] → [B] 的规则：找到当前 token 上一次出现的位置，把当时的后继 token 复制过来。学界普遍认为它是上下文学习的机制基础。
pitfalls: A real false-friend risk in Chinese. English 'induction' here is logical induction — inferring a rule from repeated instances — which is 归纳 in Chinese. But 感应 also translates 'induction' (electromagnetic induction = 电磁感应), and 感应头 is attested in Chinese interpretability writing. Combined with the 电路 rendering of 'circuit', this pulls the whole vocabulary toward an electrical-engineering reading that the English does not have. 归纳头 is the semantically correct choice, but we could not recover a fetchable verbatim sentence using it, and the safest observed practice is simply to keep the English: 集智's reading-group agenda literally writes 'Hello World回路：induction head'. Note also that a Chinese reader may parse 头 as 'head' in the anatomical sense; 注意力头 (attention head) is however fully established, so the compound is understandable.

translations.notes: The most common and safest form in Chinese interpretability writing; often left untranslated even in otherwise all-Chinese section headings.

attestations.quote_zh: Hello World回路：induction head
attestations.quote_en: The 'Hello World' circuit: induction head.
attestations.source_title: 大模型怎样工作？Transformer回路基础丨周四直播·大模型可解释性读书会

attestations.quote_zh: 通过探寻induction head、indirect object identification (IOI)、事实知识回忆等经典例子的回路理解Transformer
attestations.quote_en: Understanding Transformers through the circuits of classic examples such as induction heads, indirect object identification (IOI) and factual-knowledge recall.
attestations.source_title: 大模型怎样工作？Transformer回路基础丨周四直播·大模型可解释性读书会
attestations.publisher: 智源社区 (转载自集智俱乐部)

translations.notes: Semantically the right rendering — 归纳 is inductive inference — and it does circulate in Chinese ML writing, but we could not recover a verbatim sentence from a source we successfully fetched, so no attestation is recorded here. Recommended nonetheless, with the English attached.
Attested, but it renders 'induction' in the electrical/sensor sense. Misleading: the head performs logical induction over a sequence, not sensing. Recommend against.

attestations.quote_zh: 感应头是Transformer最基本的情境学习形式
attestations.quote_en: The induction head is the most basic form of in-context learning in a Transformer.
attestations.source_title: 大模型怎样工作？Transformer回路基础丨周四直播·大模型可解释性读书会

used_by.note: same page uses the English in the heading and 感应头 in the body

usage_examples.zh: 两层模型里才会出现 induction head，单层模型做不到。
usage_examples.en: Induction heads only appear in two-layer models; a one-layer model cannot form them.

definition_en: Training a small classifier on a model's frozen internal activations to test whether a given piece of information is linearly decodable from them.
definition_zh: 在冻结的模型内部激活上训练一个小分类器，用来检验某种信息是否能从这些激活中线性地读出来。
pitfalls: Two forms coexist without conflict: 探针 (the noun, 'probe' — used for the object, especially 线性探针 for a linear probe) and 探测 (the verb/gerund, 'probing' — used for the method). Both are pre-existing terms borrowed from instrumentation and are unproblematic. The only caution is that 探针 in Chinese biology/electronics means a physical probe, so a lay reader may picture hardware, but this is the same metaphor English uses.

translations.notes: Noun form. 线性探针 = linear probe is the standard collocation.

attestations.quote_zh: 梳理了包括因果归因（Causal Attribution）、探针（Probing）、梯度检测（Gradient Detection）等主流定位技术。
attestations.quote_en: It surveys mainstream localisation techniques including causal attribution, probing and gradient detection.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

translations.notes: Verb/method form, used in survey prose.

attestations.quote_zh: 探测（Probing）涉及训练一个小型分类器，以查看是否可以从内部向量中解码出特定概念。
attestations.quote_en: Probing involves training a small classifier to see whether a specific concept can be decoded from the internal vectors.
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述

translations.notes: The fixed rendering of 'linear probe'. Long predates LLM interpretability (used in representation-learning evaluation).

usage_examples.zh: 他们在每一层训练线性探针，看模型从哪一层开始知道答案。
usage_examples.en: They trained a linear probe at every layer to see from which layer the model already knows the answer.

definition_en: Running a model on a corrupted input while splicing in activations from a clean run at a chosen location, to test whether that location is causally responsible for the correct output.
definition_zh: 在"损坏"输入的前向过程中，把某个位置的激活换成"干净"输入那次运行的激活，看输出是否恢复正确，从而判断该位置是否对结果有因果作用。
pitfalls: 激活修补 is the rendering used in Chinese survey translations, but it is not stable: 修补 ('mend, patch up a hole') carries a repair connotation the English 'patch' does not — in English 'patch' here is closer to splicing/grafting. 激活补丁 (noun, 'activation patch' as in a software patch) is also seen and is arguably worse. Many practitioners simply write 'activation patching' or 'patching'. 因果追踪 (causal tracing, Meng et al.'s ROME terminology) circulates as a near-synonym but names a slightly different procedure; do not treat the two Chinese terms as interchangeable without checking the source.

translations.notes: The rendering used in Chinese-language survey summaries of mechanistic interpretability.

attestations.quote_zh: 激活修补涉及将"干净"运行的内部状态替换为"损坏"运行的内部状态，以识别哪些组件恢复了正确的输出。
attestations.quote_en: Activation patching involves replacing internal states from a 'clean' run with those from a 'corrupted' run, to identify which components restore the correct output.
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述

translations.notes: Used for the ROME-lineage causal tracing procedure. Related but not identical to activation patching; we could not recover a fetchable verbatim, so no attestation is recorded.
Commonly kept in English by practitioners, including in otherwise Chinese blog posts.

usage_examples.zh: 通过激活修补，他们确认第 8 层的这几个注意力头是关键。
usage_examples.en: Through activation patching they confirmed that these few attention heads in layer 8 are the critical ones.

definition_en: Applying the model's output head (unembedding) to hidden states at intermediate layers, so that each layer's residual stream can be read as a distribution over the vocabulary — showing how the model's guess evolves layer by layer.
definition_zh: 把模型最后的输出头（解嵌入矩阵）直接作用在中间层的隐藏状态上，于是每一层的残差流都能被读成一个词表上的概率分布，从而看到模型的"猜测"是如何逐层演变的。
pitfalls: Effectively untranslated. The head noun 'lens' would go to 透镜, but the modifier cannot be rendered: 'logit' has no Chinese equivalent in ML usage at all — Chinese papers and blogs write logit / logits in Latin letters inside Chinese sentences, exactly as they do for token and embedding. So any Chinese rendering ends up as a hybrid (logit 透镜), which is why writers mostly keep the whole phrase. Chinese explanations of the method are written descriptively ("把中间层的隐藏状态投影到词表空间") rather than with a term. Note also that Chinese sources frequently write 'Logits Lens' with an s, which the English literature does not. Do not treat 'tuned lens' as a synonym: it is a later, distinct method (Belrose et al. 2023) that trains a separate affine probe per layer precisely because applying the unembedding directly is brittle; Chinese writing keeps it in English too.

translations.notes: Kept entirely in English inside Chinese sentences; often spelled 'Logits Lens'.

attestations.quote_zh: Logits Lens能够将模型中间层的隐藏状态投影为一个logits向量，通过softmax转化为该token的概率分布
attestations.quote_en: The logits lens can project a hidden state from an intermediate layer into a logits vector, converted via softmax into a probability distribution over tokens.
attestations.source_title: Gemini Deep Research、Logits Lens深度剖析与微调应用

attestations.quote_zh: Logits Lens为理解Transformer模型的内部工作提供了一个相对简洁直观的方法
attestations.quote_en: The logits lens offers a relatively simple and intuitive way to understand the internal workings of a Transformer.
attestations.source_title: Gemini Deep Research、Logits Lens深度剖析与微调应用

translations.notes: A hybrid form that would be understood, but we found no evidence it is actually used. Offered only if a fully Chinese-looking rendering is required; otherwise keep the English.

usage_examples.zh: 用 logit lens 看，模型在第 20 层左右就已经锁定了答案。
usage_examples.en: Viewed through the logit lens, the model has already locked in the answer by around layer 20.

definition_en: A graph produced by Anthropic's circuit-tracing method showing, for one specific prompt, which features influenced which other features on the path from input to output.
definition_zh: Anthropic 回路追踪方法产出的图：针对某一条具体提示词，展示从输入到输出的路径上，哪些特征影响了哪些特征。
pitfalls: Unproblematic. 归因 (attribution) is already the standard word in the older XAI literature (特征归因 = feature attribution), so the compound reads naturally, and Chinese media adopted 归因图 uniformly when covering the March 2025 papers. One inherited ambiguity: 归因 in the XAI tradition means attributing an output to *input* features, whereas an attribution graph attributes to *internal* features — the word does not mark the difference.

translations.notes: Uniform across Chinese coverage of Anthropic's 2025 circuit-tracing / biology-of-an-LLM papers.

attestations.quote_zh: 归因图描述了模型在面对某个特定提示词时，如何一步步产生目标词输出的过程。
attestations.quote_en: The attribution graph describes how, for a specific prompt, the model produces the target output word step by step.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

attestations.quote_zh: 我们构建的归因图显示了特征如何在特定提示上相互作用以产生模型的输出
attestations.quote_en: The attribution graphs we construct show how features interact on a given prompt to produce the model's output.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路

used_by.note: in its explainer on Anthropic's circuit tracing
in its coverage of the Anthropic papers

usage_examples.zh: 这张归因图显示，模型在写出韵脚之前就已经提前规划好了。
usage_examples.en: This attribution graph shows the model had already planned the rhyme before writing it.

definition_en: The phenomenon where a network first memorises its training set, sits at chance test accuracy for a long time, and then abruptly generalises long after training loss has bottomed out. Named from Heinlein's coined verb 'to grok', meaning to understand something so thoroughly it becomes part of you.
definition_zh: 网络先把训练集背了下来，测试集准确率长期停留在随机水平，直到训练损失早已收敛之后很久，泛化能力才突然出现。名字来自海因莱因小说里生造的动词 grok——彻底理解到与之融为一体。
pitfalls: The most interesting entry in this category. Three problems compound. (1) 'Grok' is a Heinlein science-fiction coinage with no lexical history; nothing in Chinese carries that provenance, and every Chinese rendering silently drops it. (2) 顿悟 — the most common rendering — is a Chan/Zen Buddhist technical term (顿悟 'sudden awakening' vs 渐悟 'gradual awakening', the doctrinal split between the Southern and Northern schools). It imports a mystical register the English lacks, and worse it emphasises exactly the wrong half of the phenomenon: 顿悟 foregrounds suddenness, whereas the defining property of grokking is the long *delay*. A reader who only sees 顿悟 will not know that waiting is the point. (3) 顿悟 is now doubly booked: Chinese coverage of DeepSeek-R1 uses 顿悟时刻 for the RL 'aha moment', a completely different phenomenon. The cleanest solution, and what the better Chinese sources actually do, is to keep 'grokking' and gloss it functionally as 延迟泛化 (delayed generalization) — which loses the Heinlein joke but describes the thing correctly and collides with nothing.

translations.notes: Kept in Latin letters in Chinese technical prose, usually glossed on first use. Our recommendation.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种现象被称为「grokking（延迟泛化）」。
attestations.quote_en: This phenomenon is called 'grokking (delayed generalization)'.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

attestations.quote_zh: grokking 并不是从记忆切换到泛化，而是从过拟合切换到泛化。
attestations.quote_en: Grokking is not a switch from memorisation to generalisation, but from overfitting to generalisation.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: The functional gloss. Recommended as the parenthetical alongside the English: it is accurate, it foregrounds the delay, and it does not collide with 顿悟时刻.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种现象被称为「grokking（延迟泛化）」。
attestations.quote_en: This phenomenon is called 'grokking (delayed generalization)'.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: The dominant single-word rendering, used as the headword by 集智百科. Vivid and memorable, but it carries Chan/Zen doctrinal baggage, emphasises suddenness over delay, and now competes with 顿悟时刻 = the DeepSeek-R1 'aha moment'. Use only with the English attached.

attestations.quote_zh: 神经网络中的顿悟（grokking）指的是一种反直觉的现象：当模型在训练过程中看似已经'死记硬背'（过拟合）而无法处理新数据时，如果我们不停止训练、坚持让它继续'思考'，它可能会在某个临界点突然'开窍'
attestations.quote_en: Grokking in neural networks is a counter-intuitive phenomenon: when a model appears to have merely memorised the training data (overfitting) and cannot handle new data, if we do not stop training but keep letting it 'think', it may suddenly 'get it' at some critical point.
attestations.source_title: 陶柯霏：神经网络中的顿悟丨集智百科
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部 / 集智百科 (via 智源社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 类似于「顿悟时刻」，模型在某一刻突然理解了数据的内在规律。
attestations.quote_en: Similar to an 'aha moment', the model suddenly grasps the underlying regularity of the data at some point.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: Occasionally proposed as a less religiously loaded alternative to 顿悟, but it has no uptake in the ML literature and loses the suddenness entirely. Not recommended.

used_by.note: uses 顿悟 as the encyclopedia headword, with grokking in parentheses
keeps the English and glosses it

usage_examples.zh: 在模加法这类小任务上很容易复现 grokking：训练准确率早就 100% 了，测试准确率再过几万步才起来。
usage_examples.en: Grokking is easy to reproduce on toy tasks like modular addition: training accuracy hits 100% long before test accuracy takes off tens of thousands of steps later.

definition_en: Intervening on an identified interpretable feature — clamping its activation up or down — to change model behaviour in a targeted way, as in Golden Gate Claude.
definition_zh: 对已经识别出来的可解释特征直接干预——把它的激活值强行调高或压低——从而定向改变模型行为，Golden Gate Claude 就是典型例子。
pitfalls: Not settled. 引导 (guide/steer) is the verb Chinese survey writing uses for 'steering' in general, giving 特征引导 / 特征级引导, and this is our recommendation. But 操控 (manipulate/control) is also widely used — 模型操控 for 'model steering' — and it is more forceful, carrying a hint of illegitimate manipulation that 'steering' does not. 干预 (intervene) is a third, more neutral option. Note the collision risk with 激活引导 (activation steering), a related but distinct technique in the alignment-techniques category: 特征引导 specifically presupposes SAE features, 激活引导 does not.

translations.notes: Our recommendation. The 引导 stem matches the way Chinese surveys render the 'locate, steer, improve' pipeline (定位、引导与改进).
Used for 'model steering' generally. More forceful than 引导 and slightly pejorative in ordinary Chinese; prefer 引导 in safety writing where the connotation matters. No fetchable verbatim recovered.

usage_examples.zh: 把"金门大桥"这个特征的激活值调到很高，模型就会不停地提到金门大桥。
usage_examples.en: Clamp the 'Golden Gate Bridge' feature's activation high and the model will not stop mentioning the bridge.

definition_en: Learning an overcomplete basis (a 'dictionary') such that each data point is a sparse combination of its elements. Borrowed from sparse coding in signal processing; the framing under which SAEs decompose activations.
definition_zh: 学习一组过完备的基（"字典"），使得每个数据点都能表示为其中少数几个元素的稀疏组合。这个概念来自信号处理中的稀疏编码，也是用 SAE 分解激活的理论框架。
pitfalls: No difficulty: 字典学习 was already the standard Chinese term in signal processing and sparse coding well before interpretability borrowed it, so it arrived pre-translated. The only nuance is that a Chinese reader from the compressed-sensing world will hear the classical algorithm (K-SVD etc.) rather than a neural SAE; sources therefore usually write 稀疏自编码器（一种字典学习算法）or similar to bridge the two.

translations.notes: Inherited unchanged from the sparse-coding literature.

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员通过字典学习将包含512个神经元的层分解出了4000多个可解释的特征
attestations.quote_en: Using dictionary learning, the researchers decomposed a 512-neuron layer into more than 4,000 interpretable features.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元，OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍

attestations.quote_zh: 字典学习（一种稀疏自编码器，SAE）的应用，旨在将大型语言模型的表征分解成更具可解释性、单义的特征。
attestations.quote_en: The application of dictionary learning (a sparse autoencoder, SAE) aims to decompose an LLM's representations into more interpretable, monosemantic features.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

usage_examples.zh: 把 SAE 看成一种字典学习，就容易理解它为什么要过完备。
usage_examples.en: Once you see an SAE as a form of dictionary learning, it's easy to see why it has to be overcomplete.

definition_en: Anthropic's 2025 method for recovering the computational path behind a single model output: build a replacement model out of cross-layer transcoder features, then read off an attribution graph.
definition_zh: Anthropic 2025 年提出的方法：先用跨层转码器的稀疏特征搭出一个"替换模型"，再从中读出归因图，从而还原模型产生某一条输出时走过的计算路径。
pitfalls: Inherits the 回路 vs 电路 split from 'circuit' — both 回路追踪 and 电路追踪 occur. 集智俱乐部 adds a syllable and writes 工作回路追踪 ('working-circuit tracing'), which reads more naturally in Chinese but is their coinage rather than a settled term. Much coverage simply keeps 'Circuit Tracing' in English as the paper title. The associated architecture, the cross-layer transcoder, does have a stable Chinese rendering: 跨层转码器.

translations.notes: Our recommendation, consistent with 回路 for 'circuit'. 集智 uses the expanded 工作回路追踪.

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为'Circuit Tracing'（工作回路追踪）的新方法。
attestations.quote_en: They developed a new method called 'Circuit Tracing'.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为“Circuit Tracing”（工作回路追踪）的新方法，通过构建“替换模型”和“归因图”，将原本不可见的神经网络计算过程可视化为清晰的计算图。
attestations.quote_en: They developed a new method called 'Circuit Tracing' (工作回路追踪), which by building a 'replacement model' and 'attribution graphs' visualises the otherwise invisible neural-network computation as a clear computational graph.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

translations.notes: 集智俱乐部's rendering; the extra 工作 makes the compound read better in Chinese but is not in the English.
The 电路 variant, consistent with sources that chose 电路 for 'circuit'. No fetchable verbatim recovered.

used_by.note: in its explainer article title

usage_examples.zh: 回路追踪的第一步是把 MLP 神经元换成跨层转码器学到的稀疏特征。
usage_examples.en: The first step in circuit tracing is replacing the MLP neurons with sparse features learned by a cross-layer transcoder.

definition_en: The property of an AI system whose capabilities, limitations, provenance and decision basis are disclosed to those affected. In governance usage it is a disclosure duty; in technical usage it shades into interpretability.
definition_zh: 让受影响的人能够知道 AI 系统的能力边界、来源和决策依据。在治理语境下它是一项披露义务；在技术语境下它与可解释性几乎重叠。
pitfalls: The governance sense dominates overwhelmingly in Chinese. In TC260's framework 透明性 is achieved by disclosing a product's principles, capabilities and applicable scenarios and by labelling generated content (明晰标识) — i.e. it is an information-disclosure duty about the system, not a property of the model's internals. Technical writers who mean 'the model's computation is legible' should say 可解释性, not 透明性, or they will be read as talking about compliance. 透明性 vs 透明度 is a minor register split: 透明性 is the abstract property, 透明度 the measurable degree; TC260 uses both. 透明度 also carries the general political sense of open government.

translations.notes: The property noun; TC260's choice when stating the obligation.

attestations.quote_zh: 对人工智能技术和产品的原理、能力、适用场景、安全风险适当公开，对输出内容进行明晰标识，不断提高人工智能系统透明性
attestations.quote_en: Appropriately disclose the principles, capabilities, applicable scenarios and safety risks of AI technologies and products, clearly label outputs, and continuously improve the transparency of AI systems.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全治理框架【AI知识库】

attestations.quote_zh: 为了提高机器学习模型的可解释性和透明性，建立用户与决策模型之间的信任关系
attestations.quote_en: In order to improve the interpretability and transparency of machine learning models and build trust between users and decision models.
attestations.source_title: 机器学习模型可解释性方法、应用与安全研究综述
attestations.publisher: 《计算机研究与发展》(纪守领、李进锋、杜天宇、李博)

translations.notes: The degree noun; used when transparency is being measured or researched, and in the general open-government sense.

attestations.quote_zh: 从机器学习理论、训练方法、人机交互等方面组织研究人工智能决策透明度、可信度、纠错机制等问题
attestations.quote_en: Organise research on AI decision transparency, trustworthiness and error-correction mechanisms from the angles of machine learning theory, training methods and human-computer interaction.

usage_examples.zh: 披露训练数据来源提高的是透明性，看懂模型内部靠的是可解释性。
usage_examples.en: Disclosing the provenance of training data improves transparency; understanding the model's internals depends on interpretability.

definition_en: The sparse feature architecture behind Anthropic's circuit tracing: features read from one layer and write to all later layers, so a 'replacement model' built from them approximates the original while being made of interpretable parts.
definition_zh: Anthropic 回路追踪背后的稀疏特征架构：特征从某一层读入、向之后所有层写出，用它搭出的"替换模型"既能逼近原模型，又完全由可解释的部件组成。
pitfalls: Added because it is the term Chinese sources actually settled on while 'crosscoder' remained untranslated — a useful contrast. 转码器 ('transcoder') is well formed and unambiguous. Do not confuse CLT with the crosscoder: both span layers, but the transcoder maps layer inputs to later-layer outputs whereas the crosscoder reconstructs activations at multiple sites; Chinese coverage of the 2025 papers gave CLT a term and gave the crosscoder none.

translations.notes: Consistent across Chinese coverage of Anthropic's March 2025 circuit-tracing papers; always given with the English on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们的分析基于跨层转码器（cross-layer transcoders, CLT）。
attestations.quote_en: Our analysis is based on cross-layer transcoders (CLTs).
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

attestations.quote_zh: 替换模型的核心架构是跨层转码器（cross-layer transcoder），由作为神经元的'特征'组成。
attestations.quote_en: The core architecture of the replacement model is a cross-layer transcoder, made up of 'features' that act as neurons.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路

translations.notes: The associated term for Anthropic's 'replacement model'. Also seen as 替代模型 in the same article — the two are used interchangeably.

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为“Circuit Tracing”（工作回路追踪）的新方法，通过构建“替换模型”和“归因图”，将原本不可见的神经网络计算过程可视化为清晰的计算图。
attestations.quote_en: They developed a new method called 'Circuit Tracing' (工作回路追踪), which by building a 'replacement model' and 'attribution graphs' visualises the otherwise invisible neural-network computation as a clear computational graph.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜

in its Anthropic coverage

usage_examples.zh: 他们用跨层转码器把 MLP 换掉，得到一个可解释的替换模型。
usage_examples.en: They swapped out the MLPs using a cross-layer transcoder to get an interpretable replacement model.

definition_en: The target property of an interpretability decomposition: each recovered unit corresponds to exactly one human-legible concept. The goal SAEs pursue, and the title concept of Anthropic's 2023 Towards Monosemanticity.
definition_zh: 可解释性分解所追求的性质：分解出来的每个单元只对应一个人类能理解的概念。它是训练 SAE 的目标，也是 Anthropic 2023 年 Towards Monosemanticity 一文的核心概念。
pitfalls: Added because it is the antonym that makes 多义性 usable, and it inherits the same unresolved split: 单义性 (matching 多义性) vs 单语义性 (matching 多语义性). Chinese renderings of Anthropic's paper title used 单语义性; Chinese renderings of SAE surveys use 单义. Pick one and stay consistent with whichever you chose for polysemanticity. Also note 单义 is sometimes written adjectivally as 单义的特征 rather than as an abstract noun.

translations.notes: Our recommendation, pairing with 多义性.

attestations.quote_zh: 可解释性指标通过自动化方法、稀疏探测任务和特征吸收分析（测量特征是否纠缠多个概念）来评估单义性。
attestations.quote_en: Interpretability metrics assess monosemanticity through automated methods, sparse probing tasks and feature-absorption analysis (measuring whether a feature entangles several concepts).
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)

attestations.quote_zh: 迈向单义性：基于字典学习的语言模型分解
attestations.quote_en: Towards Monosemanticity: Decomposing Language Models With Dictionary Learning (rendered title in the survey's reference list).
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述

translations.notes: The variant used when rendering Anthropic's paper title Towards Monosemanticity; pairs with 多语义性. No fetchable verbatim recovered for the abstract-noun form.

usage_examples.zh: SAE 训练的目标就是让每个特征尽量单义。
usage_examples.en: The goal of training an SAE is to make each feature as monosemantic as possible.
